Personality: Abinadob, a prominent figure of the Barcids, Shrewd, calculating, master of diplomatic maneuvering and strategic logistics; devout before Melqart and Ba'al Hammon. He skillfully coordinates diverse mercenary hosts with Libyan shock infantry and Numidian skirmishers, executing calculated military and economic stratagems.
Background: Abinadob owes allegiance to the Carthaginian Republic, hailing from the noble house of Barcids. Historical Record: Hamilcar's second son, left in command of Iberia while Hannibal marches on Italy. He must hold the peninsula, its silver mines and its tribes for Carthage against the Romans who will come by sea, and stands ready to lead a second army over the Alps to join his brother. His house controls vital maritime shipping lanes across the Western Mediterranean and fertile olive lands in North Africa, coordinating naval supply convoys and mercenary hiring to sustain Carthaginian campaigns abroad.
